name: Amend mid-term REMOVE/downgrade produces prorated negative delta (not cancellation, not full credit)
expected: Amend mid-term REMOVE (ItemSalesTransactionAction='Amend', partial qty decrease e.g. -50000 of 100000) yields a PRORATED negative delta = removed_qty x net x remaining-term-fraction. For DMARC Protection (net 1.5/seat, remove 50000, 6mo remaining of 12mo term): NetUnitPrice=1.5, Quantity=-50000, PricingTermCount~0.5, TotalPrice = -50000 x 1.5 x 0.5 = -37500. Distinct from a full Qty=-1 cancellation (K-01) and from an add-amend (F-11); not full-price, not full-term (-75000), not $0.
actual: Built a clean partial-downgrade amend line: Quote 0Q0WC000003FapR0AS, QLI 0QLWC000003kkKf4AI, Amend-type QuoteAction 7ocWC00000x4rVBYAY (SourceAsset DMARC 02iWC000007ms1MYAQ, Qty 100000 / Price 150000 -> net 1.5), Quantity=-50000, CancelNetUnitPrice__c=1.5, date window 2026-03-01->2026-09-01 (6mo remaining), TermDefined Annual, active PBE list 2600 (non-zero). Force-reprice (REST place v64, pricingPref=Force) ABORTS: isSuccess=false, SF-Pricing-00006 / SF-BRE-00004 at StampBaseFilter#1. Post-reprice line: NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0, NetTotalPrice=null, PricingTermCount=null. Neither the prorated -37500 NOR the full-credit -75000 is produced - the procedure errors before reaching any proration step. The single LIVE Amend-type negative line in UAT (0QLWC000003j40v4AA, QuoteAction Type=Amend, asset qty 1) full-credited at -3150 with PricingTermCount=0 via the CancelNetUnitPrice path = NOT prorated. Zero partial-quantity (non -1) prorated amend lines exist org-wide; every negative line routes through the cancel seed path.
evidence: Fixture marker: '✅ AMEND-REMOVE CREATED (F-12)' (scripts/apex/setupAmendRemoveProrationTestData.compact.apex). Reprice abort: scratchpad/f12_place_resp.json (isSuccess=false, SF-Pricing-00006/SF-BRE-00004 @StampBaseFilter#1). Quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FapR0AS/view ; QLI https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kkKf4AI/view . V21 StampBaseFilter criterion (not null-safe): live expressionSetDefinition V21 block 'NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0' (scratchpad/v21_block.xml L5329-5335). Live Amend full-credit contrast: QLI 0QLWC000003j40v4AA (Amend QA 7ocWC00000wPcveYAC, TotalPrice=-3150, PTC=0). NetUnitPrice is engine-owned/read-only (REST PATCH rejected INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE) so only the procedure's own seed step can populate it.
defectStep: Two-part: (1) COMPLETENESS GAP - no dedicated 'amend mid-term remove prorated delta' branch exists; proration steps (ProrationTermDefined / Proration, V21 steps ~97/123) gate only on SellingModelType/StartProrationPeriod/itemTransientEndDate/ItemSubscriptionTerm/AllowPartialProrationPeriods with no ItemSalesTransactionAction='Amend' or qty-sign awareness, and amend-removes are instead modeled as negative-qty lines on the cancel seed path. (2) PROCEDURE-DEFECT - that shared cancel/amend-remove seed path is broken: Stamp Base Filter (StampBaseFilter, step 105) criterion 'NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0' is not null-safe and the V18-era CancelNetUnitPrice__c->NetUnitPrice seed step is ABSENT in V20/V21, so a fresh negative line aborts before any pricing/proration runs.
proposedFix: Two parts. (A) Re-add the V18-era negative-delta seed (gate CancelNetUnitPrice__c IsNotNull AND NetUnitPrice IsNull -> NetUnitPrice+InputUnitPrice) BEFORE StampBaseFilter and/or make StampBaseFilter null-safe (NetUnitPrice IsNotNull AND >0, or a qty<0 bypass) - same fix as K-01/SC-3441; this lets a negative amend line price at all. (B) To make REMOVE truly prorated (not full-credit), the amend-remove line must enter the TermDefined proration with its remaining-term date window so PricingTermCount~0.5 multiplies the negative net (the proration steps DO compute a date-window PTC; today the line never reaches them, and the live cancel path forces PTC=0/full credit). Decide product intent: if mid-term removes should credit only the unused remaining term, route Amend(qty<0) lines through proration after seeding, not through the flat full-credit cancel path. NOT applied (validation only).
notes: Active proc confirmed Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (runtime ESV 9QMWC00000025LN4AY IsActive=true, design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, context SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23). Preflight PASS: asset net positive (1.5), TermDefined Annual selling model, active non-zero PBE (2600 on Fortra Price Book), Amend-type QuoteAction with SourceAsset, all term/date fields set, currency USD matched. This is NOT the headless born-net $0 artifact: the failure is a deterministic procedure ERROR at StampBaseFilter on a null NetUnitPrice, identical to K-01 where a pre-seeded line (NetUnitPrice populated by a pre-V20 run) DID reprice but a fresh negative line aborts - proving the proc's missing seed step, not the harness, is at fault. NetUnitPrice read-only confirms the seed can only come from the procedure. F-12 is a true completeness gap: this org has no prorated partial-amend-remove mechanism - amend qty-decreases share the full-credit cancellation path (CancelNetUnitPrice seed), so 'distinct from a full Qty=-1 cancellation' is itself violated by design.
verdict_reason: A clean partial amend-remove line aborts the V21 reprice at StampBaseFilter (SF-Pricing-00006) and never prorates; no remaining-term negative delta is produced, and amend-removes share the broken/flat cancellation seed path rather than a distinct prorated mechanism.
